description: Catalog pointer for PLX company skills. Skill ids are authoritative in the skills repo manifest.json (packages[].skillIds).
notes: petralabx/skills is the canonical company skill content repo. The pin is a release tag rather than a sha: petralabx/skills tags each merge to main with v<manifest.version>, so v1.6.7 is readable, immutable, and resolves to exactly one commit. Merge this pin only after petralabx/skills#30 is merged and the release-tag workflow has created v1.6.7. v1.6.7 adds skillparity (detect runtime/machine and apply the matching install plane). v1.6.6 vendors grill-with-docs, grilling, and domain-modeling. The pin is what colleagues resolve against, so a skill published to the catalog is not installable until this field moves. Provenance comes from the ref actually fetched. legacySourceRepo documents the pre-migration source.
